Known risks (carried into every report)

  1. RANS accuracy on separated multi-element flow near a moving ground is uncertain; a surrogate inherits this CFD error.
  2. Validation needs published ground-effect wing data and STAR-CCM+ runs; see docs/phase0_report.md for what has been validated so far.
  3. Smoke-test meshes are coarse (wall functions, few boundary-layer layers); numbers here are pipeline checks, not design data.
  4. Blunt trailing edges are thinned (te_thickness) for steady convergence; this changes CL measurably (Phase 0 found ~16 % at h/c = 0.2).
